text_block_list.text:
And first place goes to Хиши Амадзон!
What a
truly powerful force to reckoned
with!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

Хиши Амадзон zips across the finish line,
coming in
like a beam of light. The
audience erupts with a
raucous cheer.

Whoa! Did you see that?! What an
incredible feat!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
And that goes for Хиши Амадзон and
Нарита Брайан
both!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We truly witnessed them for who
they
are...
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон, the Queen of the
Amazons, and
Нарита Брайан, the Beast!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I've done it... I've won?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Ama...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Congrats.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! Yeeeeeaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Хиши Амадзон!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: And welcome back, Нарита Брайан!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Applause roars through the stands of the

Nakayama Racecourse, drowning out the
words
of encouragement from the racers'
fans.

Seeing everyone so fiercely captivated,
I'm
reminded once again...

Нарита Брайан really is a beast in her own
right.
On the way back from the race...
...I want to thank you, Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh? That came outta nowhere. Are you
thanking
me 'cause I lent you my
handkerchief back in the
restroom?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'm not talking about that, you dope.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about the Arima Kinen. You
did a
good job back there.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That was an impressive finish you made.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What's gotten into you all of a
sudden?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to compete with you again. Or
have a
"one-on-one," to use your lingo.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wha—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You have... a passion about you. It
makes me feel
like I'm on fire, and
makes my heart burn.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That white-hot fire of yours makes me
want to
devour everything and everyone
in my path.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There's a fierce spark in Нарита Брайан's
eyes as she
looks at Хиши Амадзон,
bathed in the setting sun's
orange glow.

I can really sense that beast inside you,
Brian.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heh, nothing. Just talking to myself.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll gladly accept that challenge of yours,
Narita
Brian. I won't hold back on the
next one.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how many times we
clash! I'll
come out on top, every time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And so... their second battle at the
Arima Kinen
draws to a close.
